recap.text: Louis brings Carl a bucket of splooge that he says tastes like Miami swamp ass. With nine minutes left in the race, Carl gags down a full cup in apartment 130 for an hour of protection from the toxic air. The wheel turns him into a long-haired dachshund with a German accent, and Jacobus into a starfish. Carl pours a beaker down Penelope's throat to calm her, then puts his father's gun to her head.

beats.headline: Not really splooge
beats.text: At the pit stop Louis brings Carl the bucket he bought for him. It is not really splooge, he says; that is just what they are calling it. It says it is secretions, which he does not think means poop, though it smells like it. The bat dudes sell it. Prepotente will not stop talking about it: a single sip, about half a potion bottle's worth, seems to give half an hour of protection against most environments, though it has to be drunk manually. Because it tastes like Miami swamp ass, says Louis. Donut keeps a good distance from the buckets.
beats.gist: Louis brings Carl a bucket of "splooge," a secretion drink that gives half an hour of environmental protection.

beats.headline: A full cup, nine minutes
beats.text: In apartment 130 Prepotente sits in the toxic air against the leg of his mother's piano, Jurgen is stopped on Sweety in the hallway, and the race has ten minutes left. Carl pulls a full cup of splooge from his inventory, swallows and drinks it down, gagging; it tastes worse than he expected. You've been Splooged: protected from environmental hazards, and for a whole hour, which is awfully bold with nine minutes left in the race. He pulls himself out through the ceiling, jogs into the living room and spots Prepotente cross-legged on the floor. Leaving the truck, he cannot breathe for a moment and his eyes burn, and then it settles in his chest.
beats.gist: In apartment 130, Carl gags down a cup of splooge for an hour of hazard protection.

beats.headline: Dropped on a starfish
beats.text: The wheel's first attack was a Transformation, and Imani checks in at once: Elle has been turned into a goblin, Jacobus is a starfish, and she had to drop splooge on him to keep him alive. Florin's lot are unchanged, Chris is a werewolf in human form, and Prepotente's Apito memorial crystal kept him and Jurgen from changing at all. Carl is a long-haired dachshund with a German accent.
beats.gist: The wheel's Transformation makes Elle a goblin, Jacobus a starfish, Carl a dachshund.

beats.headline: A beaker for the pig
beats.text: Carl steps out of the truck with Penelope, enormous and panicking, strapped to his chest, her legs in the air. He takes a beaker of splooge and pours it down the spluttering pig's throat, and she calms. Okay, that's a delight, she writes in chat, more please; it says it's called splooge, and she craves it. Carl drinks some more himself, choking it down, then puts his father's gun to the pig's head and calls for Taranis.
beats.gist: Carl pours splooge down Penelope's throat to calm her, then drinks some himself.

relations.note: the splooge gave no air; the ring did
